about:
Mid America Woodworking Machinery, Inc. is based in St. Charles, Missouri, and serves customers across Missouri, Kansas, Arkansas, Oklahoma, and Illinois. The company focuses on the distribution and support of machinery for woodworking, plastics fabrication, and non‑ferrous metal processing.

The firm supplies a range of equipment from industrial sliding table saws to CNC routers and machining centers, and also provides onsite installation, preventative maintenance, and emergency repair services. Its parts department stocks pneumatic, hydraulic, motion‑control, and electrical components, while its training group offers CNC programming instruction and assistance with cabinet design software and panel optimization.

Primary customers include cabinet shops, plastics fabricators, and non‑ferrous metal workshops throughout the five‑state Midwest territory. The company has helped integrate robotic sanding systems from Vancouver Automation and represents brands such as Biesse, Pillar Manufacturing, and Razor Gauge.

Mid America Woodworking Machinery emphasizes after‑sales support and technical application experience, operating under the slogan “Make Machines Work Harder.” The goal is to act as an extension of the customer’s business, maximizing the return on capital equipment through continued knowledge and service.
